relationship_to_main_report: Alternative report only; does not replace the main Zoo report.
threshold_origin: New engineering defaults fixed before exercising this implementation; not recovered prior agreed values or retrospectively preregistered empirical thresholds.

tau_d.justification: Require determinations from at least 80% of the complete fixed roster; N/A never reduces the denominator.

tau_u.justification: Allow at most 10% unresolved nonmandatory checks; every mandatory obligation still requires PASS.

failure_rule: Any recorded applicable FAIL blocks ESTABLISHED.
cycle_rule: Any required dependency cycle and all its descendants remain QUALIFIED until the cyclic argument is replaced by separately reviewed noncircular evidence.
